public_wp_available_to_anon_users.name: Public working plan visible to anonymous users
public_wp_available_to_anon_users.description: When enabled, the working plan is visible on the landing page next to the login. WARNING: changes only take effect after an application restart.

birthday_calendar_available.name: Offer pseudonymized birthday calendar
birthday_calendar_available.description: Offers a subscribable calendar of member birthdays - entries show initials only, never the full name.

working_plan_as_start_page.name: Working plan as start page
working_plan_as_start_page.description: When the start page is loaded, the working plan is shown instead of the login. Requires the working plan to be publicly visible. WARNING: changes only take effect after an application restart.

show_admins.name: Show administrators in the member list?

users_can_view_statistics.name: Statistics visible to all members
users_can_view_statistics.description: When disabled, only council members and higher roles can see the statistics overview (downloads, downloads-per-file, storage usage). Council members and higher roles are unaffected by this setting.

show_seeker_names_to_brothers.name: Seeker names visible to all brothers
show_seeker_names_to_brothers.description: When enabled, brothers with no Seeker access of their own see a names-only list of active seekers (dashboard tile + own page). Does not affect the Worshipful Master or council members - they already have full access to seeker management.

notify_technical_contact_on_unknown_pass.name: Notify on password reset for unknown email addresses
notify_technical_contact_on_unknown_pass.description: A member may have forgotten which email address is on file

notify_user_on_login_activity.name: Email notification on login
notify_user_on_login_activity.description: Notifies members by email of every successful login and of accounts locked after repeated failed attempts

domain.name: Domain
domain.description: This application's domain (without protocol). Used for contact export and as an identifier in the calendar export.

lodge.name: Lodge
lodge.description: Displayed lodge name on the start page and in the page title.

lodge_short.name: Lodge abbreviation
lodge_short.description: Used e.g. as a prefix for the working plan.

default_event_location.name: Default location for new events
default_event_location.description: The "location" field on the new-event form is pre-filled with this value.

user_change_notification_email.name: Notification email address
user_change_notification_email.description: Email address that receives the report when a member's data has been changed. Multiple addresses can be separated by semicolons.

default_from_email.name: Default sender address for system emails
default_from_email.description: Sender used for all emails the application sends.

technical_contact_email.name: Technical contact
technical_contact_email.description: This email address is shown everywhere a technical contact is listed.

mvst_email.name: Worshipful Master contact address
mvst_email.description: Can be shown in the legal notice (Impressum) and the privacy policy.

street.description: Used (among other things) in the legal notice (Impressum) and the privacy policy.

zip.name: ZIP code
zip.description: Used (among other things) in the legal notice (Impressum) and the privacy policy.

location.name: Location
location.description: Used (among other things) in the legal notice (Impressum) and the privacy policy.

content_responsible_name.name: Person responsible for content (§ 18(2) MStV)
content_responsible_name.description: Name (and address, if different) of the person responsible for content per German media law. Shown in the legal notice.

technical_responsible_name.name: Person responsible for technical operation
technical_responsible_name.description: Name of the person responsible for the application's technical operation. Shown in the legal notice.

max_db_mem_size.name: Maximum database storage size
max_db_mem_size.description: Maximum storage usage in megabytes before a warning is shown.

options.max_db_mem_size_demo_locked: Not editable in this demo environment.

max_upload_file_size.name: Maximum upload file size
max_upload_file_size.description: Maximum size (in MB) for a single uploaded file. Cannot exceed this server's configured ceiling.

workingplan_footer.name: Working plan footer
workingplan_footer.description: This text is written as a footer below the working plan.

public_wp_footer_show_secretary.name: Show Secretary in the public working-plan footer
public_wp_footer_show_secretary.description: Shows the Secretary's name and mobile number in the footer of the public (not logged-in) working-plan PDF. If both public-footer switches are off, the Secretary role's stored e-mail address is shown instead, if set.

public_wp_footer_show_worshipful_master.name: Show Worshipful Master in the public working-plan footer
public_wp_footer_show_worshipful_master.description: Shows the Worshipful Master's name and mobile number in the footer of the public (not logged-in) working-plan PDF.

internal_wp_footer_show_secretary.name: Show Secretary in the internal working-plan footer
internal_wp_footer_show_secretary.description: Shows the Secretary's name and mobile number in the footer of the internal (logged-in) working-plan PDF. If both internal-footer switches are off, the Secretary role's stored e-mail address is shown instead, if set.

internal_wp_footer_show_worshipful_maste.name: Show Worshipful Master in the internal working-plan footer
internal_wp_footer_show_worshipful_maste.description: Shows the Worshipful Master's name and mobile number in the footer of the internal (logged-in) working-plan PDF.

impressum.name: Legal notice (Impressum) text
impressum.description: HTML formatting. Email addresses are obfuscated. Pre-filled with a legally compliant German-law template by default - please fill in the placeholder fields above (address, responsible persons).

datenschutz.name: Privacy policy (Datenschutzerklärung)
datenschutz.description: HTML formatting. Email addresses are obfuscated. Pre-filled with a general GDPR-compliant German-law template by default - extend it if you add further services (e.g. analytics).

help.name: Help content

mfa_mode.name: Two-factor authentication
mfa_mode.description: Controls whether two-factor authentication is optional or mandatory for all members.

mfa_enforce_for_officers.name: Mandatory for council members
mfa_enforce_for_officers.description: When enabled, council members and higher roles must set up two-factor authentication regardless of the general mode.

mfa_grace_period_days.name: Grace period (days)
mfa_grace_period_days.description: Number of days members are given to set up two-factor authentication after switching to mandatory.

mfa_trusted_device_days.name: Trusted device duration (days)
mfa_trusted_device_days.description: Number of days a device is remembered as trusted after a successful two-factor authentication (maximum 90).

birthday_calendar_consent_mode.name: Birthday calendar consent
birthday_calendar_consent_mode.description: Controls how members' consent to appear in the birthday calendar is obtained.
